title: Cheese!
description: Adding an entire production of Cheese! By aging milk inside of a Barrel!
body:
Cheese Mod

A small and simple cheese expansion that adds new cheese forms for crafting and storage. This mod focuses on compacting and preserving cheese into different item forms.

Adds:

- Cheese Wedges  
  A compacted form of cheese with a wedge-style texture. Made by combining multiple pieces of cheese together into a more condensed form.

- Waxed Cheese  
  Cheese coated in wax for preservation. This acts as the base material used to craft larger cheese forms.

- Cheese Wheel  
  A full wheel of cheese crafted from Waxed Cheese. This is an item (not placeable yet) that represents a large, preserved batch of cheese.

Features:

- Compact cheese into wedge form  
- Preserve cheese using wax  
- Craft Cheese Wheels from Waxed Cheese  
- Simple crafting-focused additions  
- Lightweight and easy to integrate into existing gameplay

This mod is ideal for players who want more ways to organize, store, and represent cheese in larger quantities.
